name: Home
overview: Scripture reveals that the home is both a physical and spiritual foundation established through wisdom and dependence on the LORD. As Proverbs emphasizes, a house is built and established by understanding and wisdom, while Psalms reminds us that dwelling in the presence of God provides divine protection. Joshua’s declaration affirms the commitment of a household to serve the LORD, underscoring the spiritual leadership within the home. Furthermore, blessings and curses are tied to the moral character of those who inhabit the home, highlighting the significance of righteousness in the household’s well-being.
